cohort: 120 adult patients (older than 16 years) who underwent surgery at a tertiary care center in India, excluding those who had a second surgery at the same location, were on immunosuppressants, had immunodeficiency diseases, were taking antibiotics, or had other infections.
finding: The prevalence of surgical site infections (SSIs) was 13.3%, and they were more common in abdominal surgeries, males, patients aged 30 or older, those who underwent emergency surgery, and those with diabetes.
